description: Extracts tables from a text-based PDF (price list, data sheet, report; up to 20 MiB, 60 pages) with page, bounding box and a quality level per table. Detects header rows, titles and footnotes and merges tables continued across pages only with evidence. Scanned pages are reported as OCR_REQUIRED, nothing is guessed. Works with any language embedded in the PDF. The PDF can be passed as upload or URL.

file.description: The PDF. A file uploaded in ChatGPT (object with download_url and file_id).
file.title: File

file_base64.description: The PDF. File content as Base64 (standard alphabet). Max 20 MiB decoded.
file_base64.title: File Base64

file_path.description: Local file path; only allowed when the server runs locally over stdio.
file_path.title: File Path

file_url.description: The PDF. Public URL of the file (http/https). Google Drive, Google Sheets and Dropbox share links are converted to direct downloads. Max 20 MiB.
file_url.title: File Url

filename.description: Original filename with extension (e.g. prices.xlsx); used to detect the format.
filename.title: Filename

max_rows.description: Rows returned per table (counts stay complete).
max_rows.title: Max Rows

name: documents_tables
title: Extract tables from a PDF
